exposure: Previous lower segment caesarean scar rupture
cohort: Women who gave birth at a tertiary care center from January 2016 to December 2016
finding: The prevalence of uterine rupture was 0.0077%, and it was most commonly associated with a previous lower segment cesarean scar, leading to high rates of maternal and perinatal complications, including death.
mod_finding: Previous lower segment caesarean scar was the most common risk factor for uterine rupture, noted in 58.3% of cases.
